title: @mj_yu/react-generate-page config
description: Folders, file names, template bodies and questions for the page generator.

$schema.description: Editor completion only. Ignored at runtime.

preset.description: Built-in preset to start from. Anything else here overrides it.

root.description: Source root, relative to the project. Must stay inside it.

vars.description: Extra template tokens. Values are themselves templated, so "@app/{{path}}" works. May not shadow Name, name, kebab, path or root.

flags.description: Yes/no questions. The id is what templates and when: clauses reference.

id.description: Referenced as {{#if id}} and as the --id command-line flag.

label.description: Question text. {{path}} and {{Name}} are substituted before asking.

default.description: Answer used with --yes, or when the question is skipped.

targets.description: Directories to generate into. Providing this replaces the preset's targets entirely; arrays do not concatenate.

when.description: Only generate this target when the named flag is on.

parentIndex.description: Write or extend index.ts in each ancestor directory, re-exporting the child.

parentIndexBase.description: Where ancestor barrel-writing stops, relative to root. Defaults to dir with the {{path}} segment removed.

templateFile.description: Body read from this file, relative to the config file's directory.

when.description: Only write this file when the named flag is on.

verify.description: Checks run against the freshly generated paths.

commands.description: Run from the project root with ./node_modules/.bin on PATH. {{files}} and {{dirs}} expand to the generated paths.

fixCommands.description: Commands that repair, run once before re-checking. There is no model here, so self-fix means your own repair tooling.

selfFix.description: Run fixCommands and re-check when verification fails.

revertOnFail.description: Delete the generated files when verification still fails, leaving the tree as it was.
